dedup_baseline: data/research/tf-proposals-2026-04-19.json (11 open proposals, mostly TF-ops: lockstep, WR outliers, Kelly cap, multi-leg adoption, pp_* feature port). New proposals below are RESEARCH PORTS, not TF-ops overlaps.

proposals.title: Port PolySwarm 50-persona swarm + confidence-weighted Bayesian aggregation to POL-TF
proposals.paper: arXiv:2604.03888v1 (Apr 4, 2026) - PolySwarm: A Multi-Agent LLM Framework for Prediction Market Trading and Latency Arbitrage
proposals.hypothesis: Our POL-TF has 16 agents + confidence flat-weighting; PolySwarm reports 'swarm aggregation consistently outperforms single-model baselines in probability calibration on Polymarket' using 50 personas + confidence-weighted Bayesian combine of swarm consensus with market-implied prior + KL/JS divergence for cross-market inefficiency detection. Key missing piece vs our POL-TF: (a) Bayesian shrinkage to market-implied prior (defends against overconfidence), (b) KL/JS divergence flag on negation-pair mispricings (free alpha on YES/NO sums != 1.0).
proposals.kill_criterion: If 14-day paper-trade run on POL-TF shows Brier not improved by >=0.002 vs current aggregation, revert.
proposals.dup_check: Not in tf-proposals-2026-04-19.json (those are ops/lockstep fixes, not aggregation rewrites)
proposals.caveat: Abstract-only paper, no numeric Brier reported. Implementation risk: reconstructing 50-persona prompts from abstract alone. Mitigation: adapt our 16-agent POL-TF + add Bayesian shrinkage layer + negation-pair audit -- capturing 80% of the architectural value without 50 LLM keys.

proposals.title: Drop-in TabPFN-2.5 replacement for current tree ensemble on S22 venn_abers_fusion
proposals.paper: arXiv:2511.08667 (TabPFN-2.5) -- referenced in Apr 2026 benchmark arXiv:2603.26611 (Conditional Density Estimation in Regression)
proposals.hypothesis: TabPFN-2.5 handles up to 50K rows x 2K features (20x v2), 'substantially outperforms tuned tree-based models' on TabArena. Our S22 fleet-best uses tree ensemble + venn_abers_fusion. Swap the tree base learner for TabPFN-2.5 (frozen) on Colab A100/T4, keep Venn-Abers head for calibration. We already ported Colab TabICL 0.21514 -- TabPFN-2.5 is the architectural descendant with explicit calibration guarantees.
proposals.expected_brier_delta: -0.002 to -0.006 on NBA (0.22073 -> ~0.215); matches or beats Colab TabICL 0.21514
proposals.kill_criterion: If TabPFN-2.5 walk-forward on NBA 19-week Kaggle backtest >= 0.220 Brier, revert (no improvement over tree fleet).
proposals.dup_check: Distinct from MEMORY note [research_2026_apr_sota_papers.md] which cited TabPFN-2.5 generically; this is a concrete port target for S22, not research.
proposals.caveat: TabPFN-2.5 is GPU-only at inference (pushes out of VM CPU budget). Run on Colab/Paperspace burst, nightly predict, commit cached probs to VM for game-day serving.

proposals.title: Adopt Generalized Venn-Abers multicalibration across subpopulations (home/away, rest, back-to-back)
proposals.paper: arXiv:2502.05676v2 (Generalized Venn and Venn-Abers Calibration with Applications in Conformal Prediction) + cross-ref 2604 conformal family
proposals.github: pending search (authors typically ship scikit-compat wrapper)
proposals.hypothesis: Current S22 uses single-calibrator Venn-Abers on pooled predictions. Paper extends VA to 'multicalibration for finite-sample calibration across subpopulations'. Our NBA has obvious subpop heterogeneity: home-B2B (lose games on rest fatigue), away-rested, playoff vs regular season. Fitting per-subpop VA heads and Bayes-model-averaging them should close the 0.22073 -> 0.21514 Colab gap without GPU dependency.
proposals.kill_criterion: If multicalibrated VA does not outperform single-VA by >=0.001 Brier on Kaggle 19-week holdout, revert.
proposals.dup_check: Not in tf-proposals-2026-04-19.json; distinct from pp_* port (tf-2026-04-19-11) which is feature-side, this is calibration-head-side.
proposals.caveat: Subpopulation definition is a hyperparameter -- wrong slicing could fragment the calibration sample. Start with 4 coarse bins (home-rested, home-B2B, away-rested, away-B2B), not 16.
